text:
alisha-cs: Heads-up team 11:00 demo for Silverpine Health. During rehearsal they flooded our us-east edge and EU saw high p95. They asked for a short regional allowlist + temporary rate lift for us-east-1 and eu-west-1. Renewal review in 9 days, account execs flagged the last demo failure.
quentin-ops: Ok can do. Drop CIDRs, expected QPS, and partner/vendor info. Do they want pinned routing?
alisha-cs: Silverpine gave `52.60.120.7/32` and analytics partner MetricLoop `52.61.0.0/24`. Expect bursts up to ~2200 qps for 20-30m, steady ~300 qps. They want routing pinned to avoid cross-region tails.
ryan-net: Recommend allowlist AL-SP-77 + a TEMP_PEAK_12H policy with max_qps 2500 and a 30m burst window. TTL 12h auto-revoke. We'll pin routing to us-east-1 + eu-west-1 and pre-warm KV + embeddings. Need security sign-off for partner CIDR.
marta-sec: Security: require signed AUP and vendor contact. Prefer mTLS for MetricLoop; if only TLS, require cert rotation within 48h and vendor attestation. Add audit note to ticket CS-15233. 12h TTL OK if auto-revoke + audit logging enabled.
nora-ae: I'll flag renewal and prep an exec blurb. Suggest a 20m runbook call with their infra lead 30m before demo.
alisha-cs: Silverpine infra contact is patrick@silverpine.health 1 I pinged him; he confirmed the CIDRs and said they could push up to 2.4k qps for a 25m run.
quentin-ops: Plan to create allowlist and rate policy. If no objections I'll schedule at 10:30 UTC to allow cache warm. Commands:
```
POST /admin/allowlists
{"name":"AL-SP-77","cidrs":["52.60.120.7/32","52.61.0.0/24"],"ttl":"12h","auto_revoke":true}
POST /policies/rate
{"name":"TEMP_PEAK_12H","max_qps":2500,"burst_window_sec":1800,"regions":["us-east-1","eu-west-1"]}
```
ryan-net: LGTM. After apply I'll run `kv-warm --prefix silverpine:session` and `embed-preload --customer silverpine` to reduce cold starts.
marta-sec: Approve AL-SP-77 only after Silverpine or MetricLoop attach the AUP in CS-15233. If partner refuses mTLS we can still approve but require cert rotation + scoped tokens.
deploy-bot: allowlist AL-SP-77 scheduled at 2026-10-12T10:30:00Z by quentin-ops
alisha-cs: Thanks everyone :pray: I'll run the runbook with Patrick at 10:00 and push the demo invite. Marking renewal on watch.
quentin-ops: Applied and pinned routing. AL created. Kicking cache warms now. Monitoring shows connections established and no error spikes.
alisha-cs: Demo finished  initial peak ~2.1k qps for ~18m, p95 in us-east dropped from ~410ms -> 68ms after changes; eu-west p95 dropped from 290ms -> 95ms after KV warm. Silverpine requests a 4h ephemeral add for MetricLoop CIDR `52.62.4.0/24` to finish a backfill. Can we do 4h?
marta-sec: 4h ephemeral OK with manual approval, scoped token, and audit logging. Require MetricLoop to attach attestation to CS-15233.
quentin-ops: Adding `52.62.4.0/24` now with TTL 4h, auto-revoke scheduled. AL-SP-77 updated.
ryan-net: Warmed the extra prefixes and preloaded common embeddings. Post-change monitoring stable, no error or auth anomalies.
alisha-cs: Demo success  execs pleased, renewal moved from at-risk -> warm/monitor. I'll send a short NPS + latency pulse to Silverpine and update CRM with metrics.
nora-ae: I'll schedule a 7-day follow-up and add a renewal playbook item. Great work team! :tada:
